analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI는 60선 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성 부재, MACD 히스토그램은 양수에서 음수로 전환되며 개선세 둔화. 거래량은 5일 평균 대비 1.50배로 증가했으나 가격은 스윙 저항선 $2,520.41에 근접하며 저항 확인. 현재가 $2,504.19는 SMA5 $2,439.66, EMA10 $2,426.89 위에 위치하며 단기 지지력은 유지하나, 52주 고가 대비 30.6% 수준으로 상승 여력 제한.
analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see approach. RSI is sideways near the 60 level, showing a lack of direction, and the MACD histogram has turned from positive to negative, indicating slowing improvement. Volume increased by 1.50x the 5-day average, but the price is approaching the swing resistance of $2,520.41, confirming resistance. The current price of $2,504.19 is above the SMA5 of $2,439.66 and EMA10 of $2,426.89, maintaining short-term support, but at 30.6% of the 52-week high, upside potential is limited.

· MACD 히스토그램 22.1135 → -8.9353 (개선 둔화): 양수에서 음수로 전환되며 추세 전환 신호 약화
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치(중단 $2,330.24): 밴드폭 38.75%로 변동성 보통 수준
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($2,443.96): 피벗 및 5일 저가 기반 지지선
· 스윙 저항선 ($2,520.41): 돌파 시 추가 상승 가능성, 현재 저항 확인
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보): 추세 전환 없이 박스권 흐름 유지
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (1.50배): 가격 움직임에 힘 실리는 구간, 신뢰도 상승

· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($1,906.18/$2,031.32): Maintaining long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (30.6%) + Current price range is a recovery phase from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram 22.1135 → -8.9353 (slowing improvement): Turned from positive to negative, weakening trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $2,330.24): Bandwidth at 38.75%, indicating moderate volatility.

· Swing Resistance ($2,520.41): Potential for further upside on breakout, currently confirming resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (sideways): Maintaining range-bound movement without trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.50x): Price movement is gaining momentum, increasing reliability.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Waiting for short-term resistance confirmation, consider buying on breakout.
